ἀκροβυστία, -ας, ή
(perh. an Alexandrian form of cl. ἀκροποσθία; cf. MM, VGT, see word) [in LXX for עׇרְלָה ;] 
the prepuce, foreskin (LXX), hence abstr., uncircumcision: Act.11.3, Rom.2.25-27; 3.30; 4.10-12, 1Co.7.18-19, Gal.5.6; 6.15, Col.2.13; 3.11 By meton., the uncircumcised: Rom.4.9, Gal.2.7, Eph.2.11.†
(AS)

1) unclean, impure
1a) ethically and religiously
1b) ritually
1c) of places

1) to be unclean, become unclean, become impure
1a) (Qal) to be or become unclean
1a1) sexually
1a2) religiously
1a3) ceremonially
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to defile oneself, be defiled
1b1a) sexually
1b1b) by idolatry
1b1c) ceremonially
1b2) to be regarded as unclean
1c) (Piel)
1c1) to defile
1c1a) sexually
1c1b) religiously
1c1c) ceremonially
1c2) to pronounce unclean, declare unclean (ceremonially)
1c3) to profane (God's name)
1d) (Pual) to be defiled
1e) (Hithpael) to be unclean
1f) (Hothpael) to be defiled

1) uncleanness
1a) sexual
1b) of filthy mass
1c) ethical and religious
1d) ritual
1e) local (of nations)

ἀκαθάρτης, -τος, ἡ, 
uncleanness: Rev.17.4, Rec. (for τ. ἀκάθαρτα).†
(AS)

A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18
§ Unni = "afflicted"
1) a Levite doorkeeper in the time of David
2) a Levite concerned in the sacred office after the return from exile in Babylon
